title: Private Journal — My Path
risk_reason: Journal adds a persistent IndexedDB feature, automatic capture, privacy controls, reflection editing and destructive management flows. It is additive and does not write to protected reading-state stores. The PWA Service Worker/cache identity also moves to V0.11.0, making deployment operationally HIGH risk.

feature_contract.identity: My Path — private reflection archive, not a generic notes/history table
feature_contract.storage: local IndexedDB database little-ganesha-journal; no account or cloud sync
feature_contract.capture: completed/displayed Daily, Ask, Three-Card, Golden Path, Remove the Obstacle and completed Lucky Numbers may be captured as historical snapshots
feature_contract.snapshot_integrity: saved reading wording is preserved by locale and is not silently rewritten by future content updates
feature_contract.ask_privacy: exact Ask Ganesha question storage is separately controlled and OFF by default
feature_contract.reflection: each Journal entry may contain a private user reflection and bookmark
feature_contract.navigation: premium timeline and monthly calendar with search, mode filter and bookmark filter
feature_contract.patterns: descriptive saved-data observations only; no supernatural certainty
feature_contract.single_delete: entry detail overflow menu with explicit confirmation
feature_contract.bulk_delete: Select mode supports multiple checked entries and confirmed bulk deletion
feature_contract.clear_all: Settings Clear Journal Data requires two confirmation stages
feature_contract.delete_isolation: Journal deletion never resets source readings or daily locks
feature_contract.delete_persistence: deleted source identities are locally suppressed from automatic re-capture
feature_contract.visuals: existing canonical tarot art and Lucky number orbs are reused as editorial visual anchors

rollback.instruction: Restore the V0.10.0 runtime/build/cache files from this commit and remove V0.11.0 Journal files if a serious regression appears. Journal data lives separately in IndexedDB and does not mutate source reading locks.
